data.name: Kashmiri Dum Aaloo
data.description: This is the most popular vegetarian dish following the same authentic principle of slow cooking in a spice yogurt based gravy.

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.sourceText: Take about 4 tbs of oil in a deep pan or kadai.

steps.action: Boil the potatoes in a pressure cooker for 1 or 2 whistle max., let it cool
steps.sourceText: Boil the potatoes in a pressure cooker for 1 or 2 whistle max., let it cool

steps.action: Peel it. Pierce each potato several times with a small fork or a tooth pick, ensuring that it doesn’t break and stays as a whole
steps.warning: ensuring that it doesn’t break and stays as a whole
steps.sourceText: Peel it. Pierce each potato several times with a small fork or a tooth pick, ensuring that it doesn’t break and stays as a whole

steps.action: Deep fry the potatoes, till they turn a little more than golden brown with slightly wrinkled texture.
steps.sensoryCue: till they turn a little more than golden brown with slightly wrinkled texture.
steps.sourceText: Deep fry the potatoes, till they turn a little more than golden brown with slightly wrinkled texture.

steps.action: Take about 4 tbs of oil in a deep pan or kadai. Heat it. Add cloves, cumin seeds, black cardamoms, bay leaves, cinnamon, asafoetida (heeng), sauté it for 1 or 2 min. on a slow flame.
steps.sourceText: Take about 4 tbs of oil in a deep pan or kadai. Heat it. Add cloves, cumin seeds, black cardamoms, bay leaves, cinnamon, asafoetida (heeng), sauté it for 1 or 2 min. on a slow flame.

steps.action: Add Kashmiri chilly powder. Mix it well.
steps.sourceText: Add Kashmiri chilly powder. Mix it well.

steps.action: Add the whisked curd and keep on a stirring it continuously till the gravy thickens and starts leaving the oil on the sides.

steps.sourceText: Add the whisked curd and keep on a stirring it continuously till the gravy thickens and starts leaving the oil on the sides.

steps.action: At this stage add all the potatoes in the pan and let it cook without stirring it for 2 min. on slow heat with lid on.
steps.sourceText: At this stage add all the potatoes in the pan and let it cook without stirring it for 2 min. on slow heat with lid on.

steps.action: Add water in the pan, sufficient enough to cover all the potatoes

steps.action: Add fennel powder, ginger powder and salt
steps.sourceText: Add fennel powder, ginger powder and salt

steps.action: Bring to boil on high flame and then for 15-20 min. on low flame
steps.sourceText: Bring to boil on high flame and then for 15-20 min. on low flame

steps.action: Check occasionally, Reduce the water quantity to almost half
steps.sourceText: Check occasionally, Reduce the water quantity to almost half

data.name: Kehwa
data.description: A light, golden-amber green tea simmered with cardamom, cinnamon, saffron, and crushed almonds.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.sourceText: Bring water to a boil with crushed cardamom (2) cinnamon (1/2 inch crushed), and saffron (4 strands).

ingredients.name: Kashmiri green tea leaves or specialized loose-leaf green tea
ingredients.quantity: a little more than a pinch
ingredients.sourceText:
Green Tea Base: Kashmiri green tea leaves or specialized loose-leaf green tea.
Add Green Tea (a little more than a pinch ,crushed generously between the palms of your hands)

ingredients.name: Crushed green cardamom
ingredients.sourceText:
Whole Spices: Crushed green cardamom, cinnamon sticks,
Bring water to a boil with crushed cardamom (2) cinnamon (1/2 inch crushed), and saffron (4 strands).

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.sourceText:
Whole Spices: Crushed green cardamom, cinnamon sticks,
Bring water to a boil with crushed cardamom (2) cinnamon (1/2 inch crushed), and saffron (4 strands).

ingredients.name: Kashmiri saffron strands
ingredients.sourceText:
Kashmiri saffron strands for aroma and a golden hue.
Bring water to a boil with crushed cardamom (2) cinnamon (1/2 inch crushed), and saffron (4 strands).

ingredients.name: Sugar or honey
ingredients.sourceText:
Sweetener: Sugar or honey added to taste. 
Stir in sugar or honey (1 tsp.or as per the taste)then strain the golden liquid into cups

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.sourceText:
Nuts: Sliced or crushed almonds as a garnish.
Top each cup generously with crushed or slivered almonds before serving hot.

data.servingNote: Unlike everyday milk teas, it is light, golden-amber, and poured fresh - often garnished with extra almond slivers and served to guests as a symbol of hospitality.

flags.message: The green tea base may be Kashmiri green tea leaves or specialized loose-leaf green tea.
The cardamom quantity is given as “2” without a unit.
The sweetener may be sugar or honey, and the amount is given as “1 tsp.or as per the taste”.
The almonds may be sliced or crushed in the ingredient list; the garnish instruction says crushed or slivered.
The amount of water is not stated.
The instruction says to turn off or lower the heat; it does not specify which option to use.

data.name: Mutton Yakhni
data.description: is a rich yoghurt based mutton gravy and does not make use of turmeric or red chilli powder

ingredients.sourceText: Mutton: 1 Kg (with bone preferably fattier cuts like breast, shoulder or ribs.

ingredients.name: Yoghurt full fat fresh Yoghurt smoothly whisked

ingredients.name: black cardamoms

data.name: Nadru Yakhni (Lotus Stem Curry)
data.description: Nadru Yakhni is a traditional Kashmiri yogurt-based curry made with tender lotus stem

ingredients.sourceText: - Lotus Stem  500 grams, peeled and cut into 2 to 3 inches whole pieces

ingredients.name: Yoghurt (Curd)

ingredients.name: crushed dry mint leaves
ingredients.sourceText: Finish with a light sprinkle of crushed dry mint leaves.

steps.action: Peel the outer skin of the stem lightly. Wash thoroughly to clean dirt from the holes, and slice into 2 to 3 inch whole pieces.
steps.sourceText: - Peel the outer skin of the stem lightly. Wash thoroughly to clean dirt from the holes, and slice into 2 to 3 inch whole pieces.

steps.sourceText: - Add the whisked lump free yoghurt to the lotus stem on high flame and keep on stirring continuously to prevent curdling. Let  the curry thicken a bit
